description: There are thousands of moth species in the UK, but the ones most commonly associated with fabric damage are the Common Webbing Clothes Moth (Tineola bisselliella), Case-Bearing Moth (Tinea pellionella) and Pale-Backed Moth (Monopis crocicapitella). It is the larvae (not the adult moths) that can cause damage to clothing, carpets and textiles. Looking for a reliable way to tackle moth activity at home? MothOut Pheromone Clothes Moth Traps are designed as a discreet catching and detecting tool for wardrobes, drawers, storage boxes, rugs and carpets. The traps help you confirm activity, understand where moths are most active, identify the exact moth type, estimate the scale of the problem and help to take the right actions and next steps with confidence. What’s included (5-Pack kit) 5 x pheromone clothes & carpet moth traps (sticky glue surface) 10 x glow-in-the-dark pads (optional support in low-light areas) 1 x dried lavender sachet (fresh fragrance for storage spaces) 1 x digital eBook with practical prevention and action steps How the Clothes / Carpet Moth traps work (simple explanation) Each trap contains a pheromone attractant designed to draw in male moths of the targeted clothes moth species. When moths enter the trap, they adhere to the sticky surface. This is especially useful when moths are hard to spot, or when damage appears without obvious signs. Why customers choose MothOut monitoring traps 1) Early detection & clearer monitoring Use traps year-round to detect moth activity earlier, particularly in wardrobes, drawers, spare rooms, storage areas, rugs and carpet edges. 2) Designed for typical household use The kit is made for everyday spaces and discreet placement. Great for wardrobes/closets, drawers, storage boxes, under furniture, carpets and rugs. 3) Pheromone glue traps Sticky Pheromone traps provide a clear signal of moth activity, helping you decide where to concentrate cleaning and inspection. Allowing to implement rapid action and prevent further infestations 4) Glow pads (optional) Low-light areas (wardrobes, under beds, behind curtains) can make traps harder to see. The glow pads can help with visibility and lure moths and other potential insect. You can also trial the traps with or without the glow pads to find what works best in your space. 5) Dried lavender sachet (freshness) Lavender adds a clean, refreshing fragrance to wardrobes and drawers. For best traps performance, do not place the sachet directly next to the trap so the pheromone remains the main attractant. Keep at least 3 meters distance. 6) Expert eBook included The eBook explains common moth types, typical hiding places, and practical actions to reduce future activity. It supports you with a structured approach: inspection, cleaning, storage habits, placement tips, and troubleshooting. Placement guide (for best results) Wardrobes / closets Hang on the wardrobe rail or place on a shelf near stored woollens or seasonal items. Avoid placing traps directly next to open windows or strong airflow. Drawers / storage boxes Place flat in drawers or on top of storage boxes. Keep traps clear of direct contact with delicate fabrics. Carpets / rugs / under furniture Place flat along carpet edges, under beds, behind furniture, near skirting boards and behind curtains. Spacing tip For the best results, use one trap per room and keep traps at least 3 metres apart. Important compatibility notes (helps avoid disappointment) These pheromones are designed for common clothes moth species most associated with textiles. If you are seeing moths but catching none, it may indicate: the moth species is not attracted to these pheromones, traps are placed too close together or near airflow, activity is coming from an adjacent area (loft insulation, behind skirting, under furniture). If you’re unsure, send us a clear photo of the moths you’re seeing — we can help identify them and advise on the best setup. Practical actions that improve results (simple checklist) Wash items as permitted by care labels (55oC heat eliminate Larvae). Vacuum wardrobe floors, carpet edges and under furniture; dispose of vacuum contents promptly. Reduce clutter in storage areas to make hotspots easier to locate. Store clean vulnerable textiles (wool, cashmere, silk, felt) in sealed bags/boxes. Safety information Keep out of reach of children and pets. The sticky surface uses a strong adhesive and may stick to skin or fabrics if touched. This kit includes dried lavender which may cause an allergic reaction in individuals sensitive to lavender.
